onboarding.skip: Skip and use the sample profile
onboarding.welcomeText: A meal plan that hits your protein and calories every single day – computed exactly from USDA data, with your store's prices.
onboarding.bodyHint: Needed for your energy expenditure. It stays on your device.
onboarding.activityHint: Workouts per week set the activity factor.
onboarding.storeHint: Prices and pack sizes are estimates for the chosen store. You can switch any time.
onboarding.budgetHint: Compared with the cost of the food you eat in a week (estimate).
onboarding.lowCarb: Low carb (max 25 g carbs per meal)
onboarding.allergyHint: Selected allergens are excluded from every recipe.
onboarding.foodsHint: Favourites are preferred, dislikes are never used.
onboarding.equipmentHint: Recipes needing missing equipment are skipped.
onboarding.sharedTitle: Which meals do you cook for everyone?
onboarding.sharedHint: Others get a standard portion, kids 60 %. Targets are only for you.
onboarding.mealsTitle: Which meals do you cook yourself?
onboarding.mealsHint: Meals you don't cook (canteen, work) count with your usual estimate.
onboarding.batchTitle: How much do you want to cook?
onboarding.targetsHint: Every day of the plan lands in these bands.
onboarding.previewHint: This is what your first week would look like. You can change everything later.

targets.title: How we calculated it
targets.intro: Every step is visible. Constants live in the code (config.ts), not an AI guess.

step.refWeight: Reference weight at BMI 25 for your height
step.protein: Protein = 1 g per lb of reference weight, at most 35 % of calories

settings.title: Settings
settings.storeLang: Ingredient names in the store's language
settings.importConfirm: Importing replaces all your data on this device. Continue?
settings.importFailed: The file is not a valid MealMath backup.
settings.offlineText: Everything – recipes, USDA values, prices and your plan – is stored on the device. The app works without internet and sends nothing anywhere.
settings.methodologyText: Every macro = grams × value per 100 g from a USDA FoodData Central record. A deterministic planner (linear programming), not a language model, builds the plan. An independent validator checks every day.
settings.priceInfoText: Prices are estimates of typical prices, not live store prices. Store websites are not scraped.
settings.stale: Settings changed. Create a new week for them to apply to your plan.

pwa.update: A new version of MealMath is ready.
pwa.offlineReady: MealMath is ready to work offline.
pwa.installTitle: Add MealMath to your Home Screen
pwa.installText: In Safari tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. The app opens full screen and works without internet.

ai.intro: Optional. Claude proposes a new recipe using only foods in the app. Calories and macros are always computed by the app from USDA data – numbers from the model are never used. Only the allowed foods and your wish are sent (not your profile). You pay with your own API key from console.anthropic.com.
ai.enableHint: Needs internet and your own API key
ai.keyHint: Stored only on this device and left out of backups.
ai.wishPlaceholder: e.g. quick, with quark, no oven
ai.computed: Computed from USDA data for the default portion; the planner scales it within its range.
ai.macros: {{kcal}} kcal · {{protein}} g protein · {{carbs}} g carbs · {{fat}} g fat
